fib: ______ is a legal system that gives great precedential weight to common law, on the principle that it is unfair to treat similar facts differently on different occasions.
common law system
A common law system is a legal system that gives great precedential weight to common law, on the principle that it is unfair to treat similar facts differently on different occasions.
______ is an ADR mechanism involving a neutral and impartial third party accepted by the disputing parties, who help to faciltate and assist the parties in a dispute to reach a mutually agreed end.
Mediation

Mediation is an ADR mechanism involving a neutral and impartial third party accepted by the disputing parties, who help to faciltate and assist the parties in a dispute to reach a mutually agreed end.
______ means right is the right to sue or defend a claim in law court.
Locus standi
Locus standi means right is the right to sue or defend a claim in law court.
______ is the law made by a delegated authority in exercise of powers to make the laws, which have been conferred by the constitution or other enabling laws.
Delegated legislation
Delegated legislation is the law made by a delegated authority in exercise of powers to make the laws, which have been conferred by the constitution or other enabling laws.
______ is the division of the powers and functions of government among the three separate arms of government, that is, the legislature, executive, and the judiciary.
Separation of powers

Separation of Powers Separation of powers is the division of the powers and functions of government among the three separate arms of government, that is, the legislature, executive, and the judiciary.
______ is made up of the President, who serves as the chairman, the Governor of each State of the Federation, the Chairman of the Police Service Commission, and the Inspector-General of Police.
Council
The Council is made up of the President, who serves as the chairman, the Governor of each State of the Federation, the Chairman of the Police Service Commission, and the Inspector-General of Police.
______ is defined as consisting of a person or body of persons exercising judicial functions by common law and statute.
Tribunal
Tribunal is defined as consisting of a person or body of persons exercising judicial functions by common law and statute.
______ is considered a branch of public law.
Administrative law
Administrative law is considered a branch of public law.
______ is an Alternative Disput Resolution (ADR) procedure in which parties agree to bring their matter to an arbitrator or panle of arbitrators who in turn, give a binding decision on the case.
Arbitration
Arbitration is an Alternative Disput Resolution (ADR) procedure in which parties agree to bring their matter to an arbitrator or panle of arbitrators who in turn, give a binding decision on the case.
______ is the exemption of a person or body from legal proceedings, or liability.
Immunity
Immunity is the exemption of a person or body from legal proceedings, or liability.
